question: What bodily form results from constant practice of this yoga?
premises: The means is yoga of constant practice.
The practitioner may attain that form.
inference: Through constant yogic practice, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
uncertainties: dvi-aṣṭa-varṣa-ākṛtiḥ is taken as a sixteen-year form
plain_english: Through the yoga of constant practice, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
